title: feat(hub): carry the review state on triage mail
body:
The webhook bridge forwards the GitHub event and action on triage mail but not the review's state, so a review event could not be told apart as approved or changes requested.

- `PrMail` gains `review: { state } | null`, set from the webhook's review state as GitHub sends it (lower-case), null on every other event.
- `mailPayload` already copies every mail field, so the workflow receives it unchanged. Readers should compare case-insensitively.
- Closed pull requests are still dropped; a merged flag is left for the close-and-merge work since it cannot be true until those events are forwarded.

Verified: `bun run check`; hub tests (151) including a bridge test that a submitted review carries its state and a check run carries null.

Refs CL-XXXX
author: TheGreatAxios
